subject: Post-call: ownership roster, buying steps, and legal sprint plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@cardwellhealth.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@cardwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: ownership roster, buying steps, and legal sprint plan

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook. Appreciate any corrections on ownership or timing.

Call highlights (30-min discovery):
- Primary use case: inference for clinician-facing summarization and search (low-latency, PHI-hardened).
- Decision criteria: latency <= 150ms P95, HIPAA-compliant controls, predictable unit economics at scale, on-prem option for pilot.
- Stakeholder signals:
  - Economic: Priya Rao (VP Product) — targets TCO and pilot KPIs.
  - Security/Compliance: Tom Keller (Head of InfoSec) — will validate SOC2, KMS, audit logs.
  - Procurement/Legal: Sarah Jensen (Procurement lead) — manages NDAs and contract queue.

Immediate asks / owner assignments:
1) NDA — Sarah to confirm whether Cardwell needs a one-way or mutual NDA. Redwood will circulate a short mutual NDA draft as a starting point (attachment). Owner: Sarah (Cardwell) / Logan (Redwood). Target: 3 business-day review.
2) Security packet & contacts — Tom, please share the primary contact for a deeper security questionnaire and any mandatory compliance attachments (SSO, KMS, data residency). Owner: Tom. Target: 5 business days to nominate reviewers.
3) Pilot scope & metrics — Priya to confirm 3 pilot endpoints and target throughput. Owner: Priya. Target: next Tue (2026-12-16).
4) Procurement cadence — Sarah to confirm preferred procurement path (PO vs SOW) and standard redline policy. Owner: Sarah. Target: initial procurement timeline by end of week.

Legal routing preference (Redwood suggestion): NDA -> DPA (if PHI) -> MSA with SOW for pilot. For rapid velocity we propose a two-week legal sprint after NDA execution with a single redline owner at Cardwell to avoid re-circulation. Proposed redline owner: Sarah Jensen + delegated signatory (name TBD).

Attachments (attached to this message):
- Cardwell_NDA_v1.pdf (attachment stub)
- One-page product summary (link in hubspot)

Proposed next meetings:
- Security deep-dive (30m) — Tom + Redwood security engineer (suggest Wed 12/16 10am PT)
- Contract kickoff (15m) — Sarah + Redwood legal (suggest Fri 12/11 11am PT)

Action: can you confirm owners and the NDA preference by EOD tomorrow? Happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

(attachment stub: Cardwell_NDA_v1.pdf, type: application/pdf)

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@cardwellhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@cardwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: ownership roster, buying steps, and legal sprint plan

Thanks, Logan — helpful recap. A couple of corrections and next items from our side: 

- NDA: Cardwell prefers a mutual NDA for vendor-engagements; please send via DocuSign and cc our legal mailbox (legal@cardwellhealth.com). I’ll confirm the delegated signatory (likely our VP Ops).
- Procurement: We typically run PO-first for pilots under $50k; anything above that needs SOW + PO. I’ll flag internal procurement lead (Priya is product, I’ll copy Esther in procurement if needed).
- Security: Tom will coordinate security reviewers. I attached a quick CSV with our security contacts for vendor intake.

We can aim for a short contract kickoff on Friday; I’m free 11–11:30 PT. Please send the NDA via DocuSign today and I’ll start routing.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Senior Procurement Manager | Cardwell Health
sarah.jensen@cardwellhealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0134

(attachment stub: Cardwell_Security_Contacts.csv, type: text/csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@cardwellhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@cardwellhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: ownership roster, buying steps, and legal sprint plan

Thanks Sarah — and thanks Tom for coordinating the security reviewers. Quick internal note and proposed cadence from Redwood legal/ops to keep momentum: 

Proposal (Redwood legal + ops):
- Day 0 (NDA sent via DocuSign) — Cardwell to confirm signatory and any baseline edits within 3 business days.
- Day 4–7 (Security questionnaire) — Redwood to get list of questions to Tom; Redwood security will fill and provide evidence (SOC2 report stub, architecture diagram, KMS approach).
- Day 8–14 (DPA & MSA redline window) — We ask for a single consolidated round of redlines from Cardwell to avoid iterative rework. If Cardwell needs internal approvals longer than 7 business days, we’ll align on a gated timeline.

Owners / redline lanes suggested: 
- NDA: Sarah (Cardwell) / Logan (Redwood) — 3 business days
- Security questionnaire: Tom (Cardwell) / Redwood Security (Grace O’Connor) — 5 business days to nominate reviewers
- DPA: Legal (Cardwell counsel TBD) / Redwood Legal (Marissa Cole) — 7–10 business days
- MSA pilot SOW: Priya (Cardwell) / Ben Carter (Redwood) — scope and KPIs

We’ll prepare a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and link the DocuSign + Drive folder for artifacts. If this cadence works, Ben will own the contract kickoff on Friday (11am PT) and Marissa will be on the call for legal intake.

One note on turn times: to keep the deal in the quarter we recommend prioritizing NDA execution this week and compressing the DPA/MSA window to two weeks total. If Cardwell requires a formal security review cycle, we can run that in parallel with DPA redlines to save time.

Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
